stories.lead: Harry Keim removal and board accountability
stories.title: Harry Keim Dismissed: Systemwide Failure or One Man Blamed?
stories.summary: A state review describes problems spanning software implementation, training, assessment practices and oversight. The public record raises a question larger than one assessor: how broadly should responsibility be examined?
stories.original_headline: Harry Keim's Removal: When the Problems Are Systemwide, Shouldn't Accountability Be Too?
stories.evidence_gaps: Held items from the November 6–7 verification notes: (1) exact removal motion, mover, seconder and individual votes; (2) directly listened-to confirmation of the announced 3–2 result and counsel's wording (machine transcript only); (3) the original November 1, 2017 Keim letter; (4) complete Tyler/DivLend contracts, invoices and training deliverables; (5) approved October 28 minutes and hearing exhibits; (6) the WinGAP '145+ of 159 counties' provider statement (not used in the text). The manuscript already qualifies items 1–5.
